plan.objective: Teach a gradual handover at the face boundary to remove seams.
plan.hypothesis: The training mask is a hard binary rectangle, so the branch learns a discontinuous handover. Worst IoU cases are Skiing_man_jensen 0.71-0.80 and Skiing_man_keanu 0.72-0.77.
plan.single_scientific_change: ba_training_mask_feather=2, training only; inference mask unchanged
plan.risk: a softer mask dilutes branch authority; if id_sim drops >.01 use feather 1
plan.fixed_contract: 24k steps, batch 2, one A100, fixed full96 at step 0 and every 2k, shadow pretrained-default validation, hard spatial BA r128 + generic r32 + PhotoMaker-default r64 at 1e-4, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240/219,217,920 params, reference scale/position jitter from CL9, mirroring off, pose-first captions capped at 50
plan.primary_metric: Undersized-face count (<0.8 of the required box) and the IoU tail at MATCHED steps via tools/datasets/measure_face_body_alignment.py. At 14k: E13=0, CL9=0, CL10=0, CL11=0, CL8=10. id_sim secondary.
plan.cross_dataset_context: The residual hard prompts (Skiing/Jumping/Dancing/Crying) and the eddie and marion identities fail identically on large_dataset (E13), BigCelebs (BC_E13) and cosmic. CL13/CL14 are architectural precisely because no dataset change can move them.
